title.narrative: Provision of Life-Saving Sexual and Reproductive Health (SRH) and Gender Based Violence (GBV) Prevention, Response and Support Services for the most vulnerable women and adolescent girls in prioritized areas.

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide Protection - Gender Based Violence and Sexual and Reproductive Health assistance to people affected by negative socioeconomic conditions and climate change in Amazoas, Apure and Sucre Regions. This UNFPA project provides protection services . The project provides humanitarian assistance to 19,849 people, including 11,057 women, 4,372 men, 4,420 children, and including 231 persons with disabilities.
